title: Overview
subtitle: Where every asset of {project} stands in the pipeline. Numbers are read from the manifests and the files on disk.
readiness.title: Assets by readiness
readiness.intro: Planned means the ID is designed only. Authored means frames or masters exist but are not packed. Packed means the atlas or audio pack contains it.
chunks.title: Atlas budget per chunk
chunks.intro: Mobile atlas memory against each chunk's page ceiling from the design manifest.
waves.title: Wave progress
waves.intro: Packed assets per delivery wave of the design manifest.
waves.none: The design manifest defines no waves.
plan.title: Plan assets from a spreadsheet
plan.intro: Import a CSV of planned assets into the plan store that studio_asset_plan uses. A dry run comes first; existing ids are never overwritten and nothing is written until you import.
plan.unmappedNote: Columns you do not match are kept on each entry as context.
plan.defaultChunk: Chunk when the cell is empty
plan.sizeNote: A size class cell is a profile ({profiles}) or a size such as 32x32; a size needs a category and clips such as idle:4@120.
plan.preview: Dry run: show what would happen
plan.dryTitle: What the import would do, row by row
plan.importNote: Written to {file}. Nothing is deleted or overwritten.
stat.budgetOpen: Open Atlas to see the budget per chunk
